generated_note: All sales, stock and store data are synthetic, generated for a fictional mid-sized Canadian grocer.

selection_rule: Among models that beat the baseline in dollars, pick the simplest one whose savings are within 10% of the best.

rules.stockout: Stock on hand runs out before the next delivery can land (days of supply on hand < lead time) with nothing on order, for items selling 3 or more units a day.
rules.low_dos: Weekly-ordered item (not produce, bakery or meat, which are ordered daily) with days of supply on hand and on order below lead time + review period, and a suggested order of 1.5 weeks of forecast or more.
rules.deviation: Forecast differs from the last four weeks' average by more than two sigma and by more than 25%, excluding promo and holiday weeks.
rules.spoilage: Fresh item where the suggested order leaves projected spoilage of at least 5 units and 10% of the forecast.
rules.promo: A flyer promotion starts this week with a category lift of 20% or more (a promotion already running is not re-flagged).
rules.holiday: A statutory holiday week with a category lift of 25% or more.
rules.new: Launched within the last ten weeks, so the forecast still leans on a reference item.

backtest.label: Hierarchical (ML reconciled store to region to national)
